cause: The workflow failed because shipping was called with reservation_id "order-17" instead of the reservation identifier produced by inventory ("reservation:order-17"). The captured sources establish the mismatch and the inventory and shipping behaviors, but no workflow source identifies which workflow component constructed the incorrect argument.
evidence: The explicit failure value for workflow-evaluation-1 was {kind: reservation-routing-mismatch}.
The inventory source returns reservation_id as "reservation:" followed by request.order_id; for order-17 this is "reservation:order-17".
The shipping generated source shows the workflow called shipping/schedule with reservation_id "order-17" and that schedule preserves the supplied identifier.
The shipping source returns the supplied reservation_id unchanged, so it does not correct the mismatched value.
